editorial:
When a quiet survivalist and his daughter pull a wounded stranger from a river, their peaceful life turns into a fight for survival. You quickly feel the danger as a brutal criminal comes looking for answers, and every choice becomes a matter of life and death. The movie keeps you close to the family, so the fear feels personal and the stakes feel high. You will want to see how far they will go to protect each other.

The action is rough, fast, and easy to follow, while the drama gives the characters enough heart to make you care. The performances feel grounded, especially when the father and daughter work together. Some twists are predictable, and a few scenes feel rushed, but the tension rarely drops. If you enjoy survival thrillers with strong family bonds, this is a great pick.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the criminal corners the family at their cabin, but the daughter uses the survival skills her father taught her to turn the trap around. The wounded woman reveals she was not a victim; she was bait used to find the criminal. She helps the family escape, then kills the criminal herself. The movie ends with the father and daughter leaving the woods together, finally free from the hunt. The last shot shows them driving away at sunrise.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival thrillers with family drama and hard-hitting action.
